pages.title: Choose a Tool
pages.text: Open a focused recipe index for each Angelsteel tool family. See $(l:aura:arcane_progression)Arcane Progression$(/l) to advance ingots through tier 12.

pages.title: Mining Gifts
pages.text: Match each tool to its block. Efficiency multiplies speed by 1.3 per level; Shatter triples it per level at hardness two or more; Disintegrate does so at hardness one or less. Fortune lends its buff level only when higher than the tool's for eligible non-crop drops. Swords gain no mining gifts.

pages.title: Tier Bonuses
pages.text: Each higher tier digs faster and grants two random bonus points among Efficiency, Fortune, Shatter, and Disintegrate. The tooltip shows the roll; bonus points appear when the tool first enters a server inventory.
